summary: Split allocations in Check Receipts: one physical check (one receipt, one amount, one deposit) with allocation lines across owner accounts (seller, buyer, payer) and a held portion when the funding party is unknown. Adds homeowner_check_receipt_allocations, the allocation fingerprint, check_receipt_set_allocations(), post_check_receipt_split() (one payment row per owner account, applied in the 209.0063 order, excess stays as that account's unapplied credit), and extends check_receipt_commit_posting() to commit split receipts. Adds the Owner Authorization Service scope check_receipt_allocations and owner_authorization_request_check_allocations(). No existing rows are added, removed or changed; single-account checks post exactly as before.

preflight.name: the allocation table does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'homeowner_check_receipt_allocations'

preflight.name: no request uses an unknown scope
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM owner_authorizations WHERE scope NOT IN ('conversion_objects', 'accounting_runs', 'arc_acc_decisions', 'closing_packages')

expected_changes: Adds a unique index so a split check has one ledger payment row per receipt and owner account.
Adds check_receipt_allocation_sha256, check_receipt_set_allocations, post_check_receipt_split and owner_authorization_request_check_allocations, executable by service_role only.
Replaces check_receipt_commit_posting so it also commits split receipts; single-account receipts commit as before.
No rows are added, removed or changed.
